sample_unit: multiple-choice pathology questions (plus 16 pathology trainees as comparators)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across three repeated test sessions
links.effect: ChatGPT consistency rate 80%-85% across three tests; Bard variability with consistency rates of 54%-61%.
links.quote: Consistency analysis revealed that ChatGPT showed a high consistency rate of 80%-85% across three tests, whereas Bard exhibited greater variability with consistency rates of 54%-61%.

links.outcome: LLM accuracy compared with pathology trainees on the same questions
links.effect: ChatGPT scored 82.2% versus Bard 49.5%, junior trainees 45.1%, senior trainees 56.0%; ChatGPT stronger on difficult questions (63.4%-68.3%).
links.quote: ChatGPT significantly outperformed Bard and trainees, achieving an average total score of 82.2% compared to Bard's 49.5%, junior trainees' 45.1%, and senior trainees' 56.0%.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT and Bard) on 150 pathology multiple-choice questions compared to pathology trainees, testing raw accuracy and consistency without evaluating any deployment practice or safeguard.
